name: Hissatsu Panda Samurai
source:
Once upon a time, there lived a panda samurai, brave and true.

The rest, dear reader, is up to you!

[From [url=http://www.insani.org/pandasamurai.html]insani[/url]]
translation:
从前，住着一只熊猫武士，勇敢而正直。

剩下的，亲爱的读者，就交给你了！

[引自[url=http://www.insani.org/pandasamurai.html]insani[/url]]
